scope: adaptive navigation shell at 900px native minimum, Workbench selected, keyboard Alt+N reversible states
reviewer: GPT-6, independent opening and comparison of real Windows Tauri PNGs downloaded from exact-source CI

screenshots.observations: At 898px native window, navigation uses narrow icon rail with accessible expand indicator visible. Workbench is selected. Breadcrumb, tabs and native runtime card remain visible. No horizontal overflow/clipping evident in screenshot.

Alt+N expands rail to labeled grouped navigation with ZYNOA brand and Collapse navigation control. Workbench remains selected; breadcrumb and main view reflow within viewport. Sidebar gains its own vertical scroll, appropriate for height.
Second Alt+N re-collapses rail to icon-only state while retaining same Workbench page and clear content area. Distinct native PNGs with restored visual state.

limitations: Screenshots are real source-matched native candidates and scoped to T03; not the 15 final M02/M19 release manifest approvals
Source-level ARIA, keyboard and focus contracts pass; screenshots alone are not a screen-reader-driven accessibility E2E
No actual editable project/workspace or persisted rail preference is implemented
P02 parent phase remains IN_PROGRESS and P03 remains locked
